 Junior Kroupi still needs time to start for Cherries again, says Marco Rose 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article According to Bournemouth Echo, Marco Rose said Junior Kroupi is not yet fit enough to start for the Cherries again.
 He indicated the player still needs time before he can be considered from the outset.
 OneFootball Videos
 The update presented it as a fitness issue related to starting games.
 Patience is required before any return to a starting role.
 For now, Kroupi remains short of the level needed to begin matches.
 Source: Bournemouth Echo
